justification: The only real correspondence is that both include a human figure with arms raised and both run their content along a horizontal band; A shows a detailed architectural relief with columns, a stepped platform, a procession of robed attendants and lion-attacking-bull groups, while B shows a solitary stick-figure beside a long undulating serpentine line and a dot. The manner of depiction is entirely different: A is naturalistic and densely modelled with overlapping figures in profile procession, B is a minimal schematic outline with no internal detail or interaction between its elements.
